cause: The b12x adapter exposed the MXFP4 indexer default 64-state kernel page as allocator block coverage (64*ratio tokens), splitting it from main-KV logical blocks of 256 tokens.
The mixed-opaque-MLA dispatch selected a fork-specific weighted GLM grouping path capped at eight groups.
A 20-layer SWA group then set a 337920-byte common slot, separately charged even for 4352-byte index pages.

upstream_comparison.finding: Upstream keeps main/index logical block coverage aligned and uses a bounded private compressor ring. Its worker also uses a common block pool; the pool itself is not the fork-only divergence.

repair: Expose existing native MXFP4 page-size support through public dsa_indexer.Caps; FP8 retains its existing 64-state requirement.
Pack main-KV and index-K components for the same 256-token logical block; both writer and scorer use 128/256 stored-state pages for ratio2/ratio1.
Remove the V4.1 mixed-opaque dispatch to GLM weighted grouping and use the existing model-derived packed grouping path, preserving distinct SWA retention contracts.
Use the upstream-style request-owned compressor ring sized for drafts, bonus and predecessor; mask older prefill writes to avoid concurrent ring-wrap races.
Keep global block IDs, existing pool allocation, scheduler/runner block tables, zeroing, copy and connector ABIs unchanged.

from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import KVCacheLayout
cache = CacheConfig(block_size=256)
cache.kv_cache_layout = 'BLHNC'
cfg=SimpleNamespace(cache_config=cache, kv_transfer_config=None, speculative_config=None, compilation_config=SimpleNamespace(static_forward_context={}), scheduler_config=SimpleNamespace(disable_hybrid_kv_cache_manager=False, max_num_batched_tokens=4096, max_num_seqs=4), max_in_flight_tokens=8192, model_config=SimpleNamespace(max_model_len=1048576), parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(decode_context_parallel_size=1, prefill_context_parallel_size=1))
